extraction.Name: Vollis Viola Huggins (Hayes)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee but no date shown; recorded April 11, 1918 by the First Nation Bank of Gregory
extraction.Buyer: Mrs. Hayes and her husband conveyed the land by deed to Fred Roberts for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612716 issued; Southeast quarter of Northwest quarter and South half of Northeast quarter of section 31, and Southwest quarter of Northwest quarter section 32, township 95, north of range 78; conveyance dated January 15, 1919; the name as shown in the instrument is 'Hayep' but Mrs. Hayes spells her name Hayes
